fix.message: The circuit-city look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs (a game: /skills/play/learning-game/scripts/new-game.mjs circuit-city).

note.message: No track: the stops are joined by gold streets (look.track with look.route for the 45-degree bends), and the pulse travels along them (references/recipes.md, Tracks).
No pulse: a pulse of light carries the journey from stop to stop along the tracks (look.pulse, follow(path, u)) (references/teaching.md, Motion).
Fewer than 3 landmark builders called: a journey needs at least three stages, each its own landmark (chip, cpu, memoryBank, towers, connector). Ignore this if you build them in a loop.
No landmark is pressable: the learner presses a stop to send the pulse there (traits(landmark, { onPress })) (references/teaching.md, Hands).
No silkscreen names: print each stage's name on the board beside its landmark with look.label (references/recipes.md, Silkscreen).

Own materials in the lesson: build from the look's materials (look.M) and builders so the board stays one look (a chip, a can, a track); a plain or shiny material of your own reads as a toy on the board.
